mechanism: Mefloquine can cause gastrointestinal adverse effects and neuropsychiatric effects that may complicate liraglutide's GI side effect profile and diabetes management; liraglutide delays gastric emptying which may affect mefloquine absorption.
action: Monitor blood glucose control closely and assess for increased GI distress or neuropsychiatric symptoms; consider alternative antimalarial if feasible, particularly in patients with difficult-to-control diabetes.
